info.title: Samora API
info.description:
Samora API lets you trigger outbound calls, manage telephony numbers, and configure webhooks.

**Phone number format:** Destination numbers must be in E.164 format (e.g. `+919876543210`) and include country code. Pattern: `+` followed by 10-15 digits.

**Call statuses:** When you fetch call details, `status` can be: `PENDING`, `TRIGGERED`, `ONGOING`, `CALL_FINISHED`, `UNANSWERED`, `REJECTED`.

**Authentication:** Some endpoints use organization API keys, while workspace telephony endpoints use Bearer tokens from dashboard authentication.

post.description: Triggers an immediate outbound call using the specified AI agent. The call is queued and processed asynchronously.

400.description: Bad request - invalid request body or phone number format

value.message: Invalid phone number format. Please use E.164 format (e.g., +919876543210)

404.description: Agent not found or does not belong to your company

value.message: Agent not found or does not belong to your company

get.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific call by its ID. The call must belong to an agent that belongs to your company. Transcript and recording URLs are presigned and valid for 60 minutes.

parameters.name: call_id
parameters.description: The UUID of the call to retrieve. Returned as `call_id` from the Trigger call endpoint.

400.description: Bad request - invalid call ID format

404.description: Call not found or does not belong to your company

value.message: Call not found or does not belong to your company

get.description: Lists available phone numbers from current provider inventory. Results can be paginated and filtered by region.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default: 20.

post.description: Purchases phone number and adds it to your workspace inventory.

403.description: User not allowed to purchase numbers

get.description: Lists purchased phone numbers in your workspace. Optionally filter by assignment status.

delete.description: Releases purchased phone number from your workspace inventory.

put.description: Links purchased phone number to agent.

400.description: Invalid agent type or ID format

put.description: Unlinks purchased phone number from agent.

400.description: Invalid agent type or ID format

409.description: Agent not linked to this number

post.description: Creates a draft campaign for an outbound agent. Send `multipart/form-data` and include a `file` field to upload the campaign CSV in the same request.

400.description: Invalid request body or CSV file

get.description: Lists campaigns across the workspace. You can filter by campaign status, agent, search term, and sort order.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Repeat the query param to filter multiple statuses.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Repeat the query param to filter multiple agent IDs.

get.description: Returns campaign details and aggregate call stats for a single campaign.

400.description: Invalid agent ID or campaign ID

post.description: Starts or pauses a campaign from a single endpoint. Use `action=start` to move a draft or paused campaign into progress. Use `action=pause` or `action=stop` to pause it.

get.description: Downloads campaign reporting output. Without query parameters the response returns a presigned `report_url`. If you pass query filters, the endpoint streams a CSV file using the same filters as the scheduled-calls listing endpoint.

200.description: Report URL or streamed CSV report

400.description: Invalid campaign ID or query params

get.description: Lists calls created under a campaign, along with campaign-level call stats.

parameters.name: tags[]
parameters.description: Repeat to filter by multiple tags.

400.description: Invalid agent ID, campaign ID, or query params

post.description:
Creates a new webhook to receive call event notifications.

The webhook secret is returned only once during creation and should be saved securely.

value.message: Webhook created successfully. Save the secret - it will not be shown again.

403.description: Agent does not belong to your company

value.message: Agent does not belong to your company

get.description: Lists all webhooks for your company. Optionally filter by agent_id.
Returns the catalog of available webhook event types and their descriptions.

events.description: Triggered when a call begins (inbound or outbound). Basic call info available.
Triggered when a call ends with transcript and recording available.
Triggered when a call fails, is rejected, or goes unanswered.

get.description: Retrieves details of a specific webhook by ID.

403.description: Webhook does not belong to your company

value.message: Webhook does not belong to your company

put.description: Updates an existing webhook configuration. All fields are optional.

parameters.name: webhook_id
parameters.description: The UUID of the webhook to update

delete.description: Deletes a webhook. This action cannot be undone.

parameters.name: webhook_id
parameters.description: The UUID of the webhook to delete

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Your unique organization API key. Required on all requests.

BearerAuth.description: Workspace Bearer token from dashboard authentication.

agent_id.description: The UUID of the AI agent to conduct the call.

to_number.description: The destination phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +919876543210). Must include country code. Pattern: + followed by 10-15 digits.

metadata.description: Optional. Additional metadata to pass context to the agent (e.g. customer information, call objectives). Arbitrary key-value pairs.

call_id.description: The unique identifier for the call (UUID). Use this to fetch call details later.

agent_id.description: The UUID of the AI agent that conducted the call.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the call record was created (ISO 8601).

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the call record was last updated (ISO 8601).

started_at.description: Timestamp when the call started (ISO 8601). Null if not yet started.

ended_at.description: Timestamp when the call ended (ISO 8601). Null if not yet ended.

transcript_url.description: Presigned URL to access the call transcript (valid for 60 minutes). Null if not available.

recording_url.description: Presigned URL to access the call recording (valid for 60 minutes). Null if not available.

call_variables.description: Additional variables associated with the call (e.g. metadata passed at trigger time). Null if none.

include_transcript.description: Include the full call transcript in webhook payload.

include_recording_url.description: Include the call recording URL in webhook payload.

CustomHeaders.description: Custom HTTP headers to send with webhook requests.

agent_id.description: The UUID of the agent this webhook is associated with.

name.description: A friendly name for this webhook.

url.description: The HTTPS URL where webhook payloads will be sent.

events.description: List of event types to subscribe to.

events.description: List of event types to subscribe to.

agent_id.description: The agent this webhook is associated with.

description.description: Description of when this event fires.

available_data_options.description: Data options available for this event type.

cost.description: Display cost in smallest billing unit used by workspace UI.

country.description: Country code for number inventory item.

monthly_rental_fee.description: Monthly rental fee as decimal string.

file.description: Optional CSV file. The first column must be named `Numbers`.
